snippet.title: God of Stocks - Official Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
God of Stocks is an incremental management game about manipulating the market to get filthy rich. Buy low, sell high, chain absurd combos and earn divine blessings from stock market gods. Will you play it safe or risk everything?

Wishlist on Steam Now!
